text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Three killed in Tel Aviv cafe bombing.
- Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu: This is not peace.
- Two days of clashes in Hebron leave over 100 wounded.
- Three women killed in Tel Aviv attack; 61 wounded, 16 still in hospital. Mother of the baby girl in clown costume died en route to the hospital.
- U.S. President Bill Clinton to Netanyahu: Set up a unity government, U.S. official in Washington tells Haaretz.
- The father: I saw my daughter on television in the arms of the policewoman.
- Commentator Nahum Barnea: Yasser, Go to Gaza!
- The expectation: Bank of Israel Governor Jacob Frenkel won't reduce the interest rate today.
- Round of appointments expected soon at El Al Israel Airlines.
- Shani, six-year-old girl, left without a mother.
